candidates.text: A user with a positive PNL must pay the performance fee on exit; any bypass of fees is not permitted.
evidence_ids: Performance fee is charged for the user with a positive PNL in the vault. PNL is calculated by withdrawal amount redeemed by share balance minus principal represented by `userBasis`.

The performance fee follows a non-positive-then-zero mechanism, which means the vault operates as a non-zero-sum game. If more users with negative PNL are willing to exit, and more users with positive PNL make trades with them (winners bypass fees and losers get compensated somehow), then it will cause more harm to the protocol's interests. After all, it is unfair to allow any bypass of fees.

candidates.text: A user's userBasis, representing principal, should remain constant across transfers rather than being changed by transfers between users.
evidence_ids: Between different users, multiple transfers can make `balance` unchanged (representing the same withdrawable amount despite fees) while changing `userBasis` (representing the principal which should have been constant). Then the winning user can fabricate a non-positive PNL to bypass the performance fee.
Consider enforcing full transfer or redesigning the balance-basis relationship and performance fee calculation.
